title: Swap-free time-series momentum on BrightFunded FX / metals / energy CFDs as a bf2 sleeve
universe: EURUSD GBPUSD USDJPY AUDUSD USDCAD USDCHF NZDUSD XAUUSD XAGUSD WTI BRENT NATGAS (Dukascopy hourly BID, 2013+)
rule: daily close = last hourly close of the UTC day; signal = mean of sign(21-day), sign(63-day), sign(252-day) return (Moskowitz-Ooi-Pedersen style blend, not tuned); weight = signal x 0.10 / (60-day realised daily vol x sqrt(252)), capped at 2, divided by the number of assets with data; decided at the day's close, held the next day (hourly P&L on the bf hour grid). Costs per unit turnover: FX 1 bp, metals 2 bp, energy 3 bp; no swap (swap-free account)
why: trend in FX/commodities is a different return source from crypto; earlier CFD trend tests paid swap; on a swap-free account the financing cost disappears
pass: sleeve 2014-19 > 0 (pre-check, daily), DEV 2020-22 > 0, TEST >= 0.5, HOLD >= 0.3 AND strict rule vs bf2 uncapped (2.378 / 3.699 / 2.118)
caveat: requires that BrightFunded's swap-free add-on covers FX, metals and energy; otherwise the result does not apply
